name: 衣索比亞 耶加雪菲 日曬 G1
rationale: 高海拔淺焙日曬豆，花果香氣豐富且質地細緻。建議使用 Hoffmann 高溫單杯法與較細研磨，完整釋放花香與明亮果酸。
rationaleEn: High-altitude Ethiopian natural with bursting floral and stonefruit vibrancy. The Hoffmann high-temperature single cup unlocks explosive sweetness and pristine jasmine clarity.

name: 哥倫比亞 考卡 藝妓 水洗
rationale: 極致花香與優雅茶感。建議使用 Lance Hedrick 1-2-1 雙悶蒸法，以高浸潤度釋放層次分明的橙花與蜂蜜柚子調。
rationaleEn: Superb white florals and delicate tea-like mouthfeel. The Lance 1-2-1 double bloom extracts nuanced florals and sweet citrus without dryness.

name: 巴拿馬 翡翠莊園 藍標 藝妓
rationale: 頂級藝妓品種，92°C 標準手沖法能平衡酸質與甜感，獲得極致乾淨的茶韻與花香。
rationaleEn: World-renowned Geisha terroir. Standard 92°C 3-stage drip creates exceptional harmony between sparkling citric acidity and lingering cane sugar sweetness.

name: 肯亞 涅里 AA 雙重水洗
nameEn: Kenya Nyeri Hill AA Double Washed
rationale: 肯亞 AA 擁有厚實果酸與豐富糖分。粕谷哲 4:6 法可藉由前段水量調控酸甜平衡，並以粗研磨展現深色漿果風味。
rationaleEn: Intense phosphoric vibrancy and blackcurrant richness. Tetsu Kasuya 4:6 coarse grind controls high acidity into rich berry syrup.

name: 瓜地馬拉 花神 聖羅莎
rationale: 經典中美洲中焙堅果巧克力調性。標準手沖法 92°C 3段注水萃取最適焦糖甜感與柔和酸度。
rationaleEn: Classic Antigua nutty chocolate comfort. Standard 3-stage drip extracts maximum toffee sweetness and smooth, round body.

name: 哥斯大黎加 塔拉珠 音樂家 蕭邦
rationale: 特殊厭氧蜜處理帶來濃烈發酵果香。April 六段注水法能以穩定溫和擾流均勻萃取複雜果香，避免過度苦味。
rationaleEn: Intense anaerobic fermentation with candied strawberry and floral perfume. The April flat-bed recipe distributes gentle pulses to capture sweet complexity without astringency.
